summary: [spec-fidelity] The bound test of atip.codestored.02 does not exercise the signature file or the spec file the scenario names. `atip_codestored_02_a_config_a_signature_and_a_spec_file_are_told_by_their_cause` (name and doc comment say signature and spec file) only varies canon.yaml and runs `inventory sync`; the evidence record binds that test plus two `read_cause` unit tests that restate the helper's own mapping (tautology). No test at all reaches STRATEGY_SIGNATURE_DENIED, SPEC_ROOT_DENIED or SPEC_ROOT_INVALID, PLAN_CORPUS_DENIED or PLAN_CORPUS_INVALID, PLAN_DOCUMENT_INVALID (the last two I drove by hand and they answer as the brief says: `task done` on an unreadable tasks.md -> PLAN_CORPUS_DENIED, on a row that is absent -> PLAN_DOCUMENT_INVALID, both exit 2). spec030_reads covers only the signature NOT_FOUND and INVALID, unbound. Fix: tests (skipped as root with the message) for a signature file at mode 000 and for an unreadable plan document, and bind them to this scenario; rewrite the scenario's Then or the test name so they say what is proved. Blast radius: the SPEC_ROOT_* pair is also wrong in its cause, see finding 7.
